correctness.rationale: For the unfilled 5-vertex house graph (edges 01,12,23,30,14,24), an incidence (v,w) is present only when w is the unique earlier neighbor of v in a total order. Exhausting 5!=120 orders independently gives 37 distinct generated matchings, 18 maximal, and 48 nonempty simplices with f=(12,28,8). Every one of the eight displayed edge/triangle pairs was checked in order as a unique free coface, leaving a connected graph with 12 vertices, 20 edges; its cycle rank is 20-12+1=9. This proves the integral wedge-of-nine-circles homotopy type by actual simplicial collapse, not just homology. The reflection (0 3)(1 2) permutes directed incidences, with signed chain traces (0,0,0) as stated; the Lefschetz number is zero and H1 reflection trace is +1, hence rational eigendimensions (5,4). The triangle is explicitly unfilled; the full strong, pure strong, ordinary Morse and graph-edge matching complexes are distinct.
